wellFormedness.message: There is a delegation cycle: "G13: Room selected", a subgoal of "G12: Hotel booked", delegated to "Hotel Service", is delegated back to "Hotel"

security.message: "Tourist" requires "Hotel" not to redelegate "G3: Hotel booked", and yet "Hotel" delegates "G10: Hotel booked" to "Hotel Service"
"Tourist" prohibits "Hotel" the modification of "I1: Personal data", but "Hotel" modifies "R8: ID Doc Copy", which makes "I1: Personal data" tangible, for "G10: Hotel booked"
"Tourist" prohibits "TAS" the transmission of "I2: Itinerary", but "TAS" transmits "R4: Itinerary details", which makes "I2: Itinerary" tangible, to "Amadeus Service"
"Tourist" prohibits "TAS" the transmission of "I3: Destination", but "TAS" transmits "R4: Itinerary details", which makes "I3: Destination" tangible, to "Amadeus Service"
"Tourist" prohibits "TAS" the transmission of "I4: Schedule", but "TAS" transmits "R4: Itinerary details", which makes "I4: Schedule" tangible, to "Amadeus Service"
"TAS" has no right to the production of "I1: Personal data", but authorises "Amadeus Service" to it
"TAS" has no right to the production of "I2: Itinerary", but authorises "Amadeus Service" to it
"TAS" has no right to the production of "I3: Destination", but authorises "Amadeus Service" to it
"TAS" has no right to the production of "I4: Schedule", but authorises "Amadeus Service" to it
A separation of duties is required between "G8: eticket generated" and "G9: credit card verified", but "Amadeus Service" may pursue both
A separation of duties is required between "G13: Room selected" and "G14: Prepayment made", but "Hotel Service" may pursue both
A combination of duties is required between "G2: Tickets booked" and "G3: Hotel booked", but "Amadeus Service", "Hotel Service", "Payment Service", "TAS" and "Hotel" may perform one without the other

threats.message: The event "E1: ID Doc stolen" threatening "R8: ID Doc Copy" threatens also "G10: Hotel booked", "G3: Hotel booked", "G1: Trip planned", "R1: Traveling Order", "R3: Traveling Order", "G4: Tickets booked", "G2: Tickets booked", "R2: ID Doc Copy"
The event "E2: Ticket lost" threatening "G6: Train ticket booked" threatens also "R5: Tickets"

noRedelegation: Tourist → Hotel, Hotel booked, redelegated to Hotel Service
